_comment: Environmental presets and junction-temperature derating limits. Every entry cites its source; check the current revision of each document before using it for qualification.

environments.name: MIL-STD-810H Hot-Dry (A1)
environments.source: MIL-STD-810H Method 501.7, Table 501.7-I (high temperature climatic design types)
environments.notes: Ambient = operational air temperature; induced = storage/transit (solar-loaded enclosed space)

environments.name: Military temperature range (microcircuits)
environments.source: Operating case range -55/+125 C used for MIL-PRF-38535 class Q/V devices; storage range typical -65/+150 C
environments.notes: This is a device rating, not a climate: use it as a case-temperature limit check, not as an ambient
